properties.name: demo-castle-courtyard
properties.description: Example: a 45x40 m medieval castle courtyard (walls, corner towers, gatehouse with a closed gate, well, market stalls) as the external layout "CastleCourtyard", with PlayerSpawn and KeySpot markers.

events.comment: The courtyard is the external layout "CastleCourtyard" (centered on 0;0, 50 pixels = 1 meter). PlayerSpawn (1) and KeySpot (10) instances are markers: where a player starts and where pickups can be hidden.
